critical_code_review_comments: server.py L1532: summary returns out[:limit*2] assuming exactly 2 accounts; if more accounts ever added (DC_ACCOUNTS extended) this slice cap would silently truncate weeks. Recommend slicing by distinct week count instead.
server.py L1448: list_daily_chats sorts by date asc + created_at asc — fine for table view, but front-end may want most-recent first; minor UX consideration.

DailyChat.jsx L137: deleteRow uses native window.confirm — not testable in headless without auto-accept, and inconsistent with rest of app's modal styling. Consider replacing with shadcn AlertDialog for consistency (also was the only blocker for fully exercising row-delete-{id} in playwright; resolved with page.on('dialog') handler).
server.py L1469: insert_one(doc.copy()) — Motor mutates dict to add _id; using .copy() guards subsequent broadcast — good. Then re-fetches with {_id:0} — clean, _id never leaks. ✓

server.py L1456: dc_week_key uses datetime.fromisoformat(date_iso).date() with timezone-naive Monday calc; date param is YYYY-MM-DD so safe, but if a future caller passes ISO with tz, .date() drops it. Acceptable for current usage.
DailyChat.jsx export-csv-btn: filename uses week_key — confirmed 'daily-chat-2026-05-W1.csv'. ✓
Settings.jsx dc-template-input: uses textarea-style or single-line input — verify multi-line newlines preserved on round-trip (not tested, low priority since default template includes \n).
